items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Leonard, the producer, I've forgotten his name - [INTERVIEWER] Leonard Harper.

ctx.x: Connie's Inn. A friend of his took me there and ...He said, "I have a little girl who can play everything you composed." Now this man was a giant. Leonard, the producer, I've forgotten his name -

He said, "All right, Fats, we're ready for the music after you give the girl some routines." I'd say, "O.K." He'd bring out his jug and what-not and he'd say, "What's the title? What you doing?" Leonard would tell him the story. And the man would play it straight off, lyric and everything, a whole 32-bar song... So I was sitting over in the corner. This man had moved there because he was going to put them on, like a bet. He'd say, "This girl can play everything she heard you compose." "She can't!" "I bet you!" So…
